incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC1234567 - embeddings-eu high 5xx rate (>8% over 5m). Pager: pagerduty@redwood :rotating_light:
alice.m: acked INC1234567 - I'm on it, grabbing context.
ben_r: thanks — what's the customer impact?
alice.m: quick snapshot: analytics-saas and customer-x are top callers; ~12% of embedding requests return 5xx, some fallbacks return 502. latency up ~2x.
carla: runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/embeddings-eu — start with pods + logs, then scale, then enable cached fallback.
david-sre: oncall here. if HPA isn't reacting, do manual scale. `kubectl -n inference scale deploy embeddings-eu --replicas=6`
alice.m: doing manual scale now, will tail logs.
alice.m: command output: ```scaled deployment embeddings-eu to 6 replicas
waiting for pods to become ready...```
emma-ops: I'll notify Customer Ops and prepare a short template (no external comms yet). which customers should we preemptively ping?
alice.m: analytics-saas (acct A123) + internal QA. pinged sales + AMs.
ben_r: any repeatable error pattern in logs?
alice.m: seeing `model-proxy: upstream read timeout` and a lot of `kvcache miss` spikes — looks like cache eviction + upstream slowdown.
carla: quick mitigation: enable hot-key caching config. `PATCH /cache/config {"accept_hot_keys":true}` (applies without restart)
alice.m: hot-key flag applied. patch response: `200 OK` — monitoring.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC1234567 acknowledged by alice.m at 1745678905
david-sre: 60s after scale + cache flag: 5xx down to ~3%, p50 latency back to ~220ms.
emma-ops: noted. escalated to #customer-ops with suggested comms: short note + ETA for fix.
ben_r: can we short-term rate-limit the biggest callers to prevent thrash?
carla: added per-caller qps throttle on edge for top callers: `analytics-saas qps=20` — monitoring effect.
alice.m: opening tracker ticket INC-1745678901, severity P2. PR for eviction fix created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987 — patch scheduled tomorrow.
david-sre: good. keeping bridge open. I'm staying on the incident for now; alice, if you need to handoff, call me out.
alice.m: copy — I'll do a final check in 5m then hand off if stable. current plan: ACK -> scale -> cache hotfix -> throttle -> verify -> postmortem.
emma-ops: prepping customer comms standby. no wide outage yet, but risk if upstream model supplier slips further.
ben_r: agree we should also add a temporary fallback to cached-embeddings for high-volume callers until fix is in production.
carla: enabled cached fallback for calls older than 3s processing time. watching for false positives.
alice.m: errors trending down. will leave monitoring up for 15m. next update at or before 1745678967.
david-sre: sounds good. summary: acknowledged -> mitigations applied -> error rate reduced -> monitoring. continuing until handlers confirm stabilization.
alice.m: thanks all — tagging this thread for handoff notes and post-incident writeup. :white_check_mark:
